h: DSS arraigns Atiku supporter over alleged fake Tinubu letter to the US President
p: The Department of State Services has reportedly taken an Atiku supporter to court for allegedly sharing a forged letter said to be from President Tinubu to the US President. The defendant's plea and the next hearing date were not immediately clear.
more: The case comes as campaigns for the 2027 presidential race heat up.
The Atiku camp had not responded to the arraignment at the time of reporting.
